title: 第十一章 遗产捐给大熊猫
slug: 米花大舞台开局扮演工藤新一
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“咦！？新酱为什么这么问？是想要弟弟妹妹了吗？”工藤有希子的语气里疑惑不多，兴奋倒是比较多。好像在等着工藤新一开口说想要弟弟妹妹，她就有理由转头找工藤优作努力一下了。

“才不是。”工藤新一不近人情的否认了：“是这边来了一位阿笠博士亲戚家的小孩。六七岁的样子，戴着个眼镜，可他的长相……和我很像啊。”

“博士他还有亲戚啊！”有希子的惊叹传来，从越洋延迟考虑，应该是工藤新一话还没说完就下意识惊叹了。

又等了一秒钟：“很像？有多像？”

“几乎和我小时候一模一样。就是笑起来有点傻，没我帅，比我笨。”工藤新一毫不客气的说道。

至于柯南脸上戴着的就是副空镜框这件事，看在这是个漫画世界的份上，他就不吐槽了。

“更关键是他的名字啊，江户川柯南，江户川乱步的江户川、柯南道尔的柯南。”则是说了另一个槽点：“这种满脑子都是推理小说的名字感觉只有老爸才起的出来。”

“说的有道理啊。”重洋之外，身处挪威的工藤有希子看向了自己的身边：“亲爱的，你怎么看？”

这里是书房，不仅是工藤有希子，工藤优作也在电话机旁。

“老爸也在啊。”

“六到七岁的小男孩……江户川柯南。”工藤优作接过了电话：“新一，你记得在我的书房里《两分铜币》的位置吗？”

“我记得……”工藤新一昨晚在书房转了三圈，稍作回忆就能答道：“西北角的书架上，第二层中间的位置，旁边就是《血字的研究》。”

接着勾起嘴角：“书架第二层的高度和一个六七岁的小男孩差不多，这两本挨在一起的书刚好与他的视角平齐。”

工藤优作满意地点点头，他刚听到‘江户川柯南’这个名字，就觉得这是一个小孩在情急之下看到啥叫啥，起出来的假名。果然自己的儿子也不傻，一点就通，立刻想到了这一点。

但工藤新一依然质疑：“你们想想，突然冒出来一个小孩，长相和我非常的像，还遮遮掩掩的不告诉我他的真名，阿笠博士貌似也在帮他打掩护——我感觉我的继承权都不稳定了！”

“放心吧，只有你一个逆子已经够让我们头疼的了。”工藤有希子不耐烦了。

她只能保证自己肯定没生过第二个，但是工藤优作这个经常和女粉丝眉来眼去的家伙……她现在急需挂断电话拷问一番。

“真的吗？我已经开始录音了哦，你们能保证，我真的是咱们家唯一的孩子、家产的唯一继承人吗？”

“是真的是真的，但是你再废话老娘就把遗产全都捐给大熊猫。”

说着，有希子就要挂断电话，仔细盘问一下工藤优作有没有干对不起自己的事。

工藤优作也知道挂断电话后自己要面对什么，伸出手阻止了有希子挂电话，自己接了过来：“新一，为什么这么在意家产的事，是有想要的东西吗？还有你刚刚说这是第一件事，第二件事是什么？”

工藤优作能感觉到，工藤新一的这通电话还有其他的目的，他怀疑工藤新一是缺钱了，而且是一大笔钱。

这孩子虽然作为侦探还有许多不成熟的地方，但应该不至于傻到沉迷赌博，那是炒股炒到上天台了？还是想要买什么很贵的东西？

算算时间，这孩子也17岁了，过了生日就可以考驾照开车了，莫非是想要豪车？

他有些担心，工藤新一受社会物欲的影响，开始想要豪车一类的奢侈品了。他虽然是个比较有名的小说作家，但也只能说生活优渥，供不起这小子当奔驰金条大金劳的那种富二代啊。

“另一件事就是跟您二老报备一下。毕竟那小鬼名义上是阿笠博士的亲戚嘛，我就让他借住在咱们家了，顺水推舟也让小兰住下了。”

“小兰！？”有希子立刻又将听筒抢了过去：“你现在和小兰住在一起了？这么快？”

“顺势而为嘛。”工藤新一的语气里带着点小得意：“所以您二位最近不要轻易回家，万一小兰看到你们害羞跑了怎么办。”

“还有就是，我这边现在也算个‘三口之家’了。”工藤新一嘿嘿一声：“生活费是不是给涨一涨。”

“涨！”有希子高兴地答应道：“优作有一笔私房钱攒了两年了，妈妈等会就给你打过去。”

工藤优作：啊！？

电话挂断了。

工藤优作试图转移话题：“有希子，关于新一提到的那个小孩，你怎么看？”

“难道不是某个大作家在外面四处留情的私生子吗？”有希子的双手搭在了工藤优作的双肩上，低语的红唇距离他的耳朵越来越近。明明是非常暧昧的举动，却让工藤优作心里汗毛倒竖。

中年夫妻吻一口，噩梦能做好几宿……不对，不是因为这个。

“有希子，我一直都忠贞于我们的婚姻，从来没有留过情啊。”

“是吗？那上个月的17号，你鬼鬼祟祟去餐厅见面的女人是谁？别跟我说只是粉丝……”

"Eh!? Why do Shin-chan ask that? Do you want younger siblings?" Kudo Yukiko's tone was less confused and more excited.It seemed that she was waiting for Kudo Shinichi to say that he wanted younger siblings, so that she would have a reason to turn to Kudo Yusaku and make an effort.

"No." Kudo Shinichi denied unkindly: "It's a child from a relative of Dr. Agasa. He looks six or seven years old and wears glasses, but his appearance...is very similar to mine."

"Doctor, he has relatives!" Yukiko exclaimed. Considering the delay in crossing the ocean, Kudo Shinichi must have subconsciously exclaimed before he finished speaking.

Waited for another second: "It's very similar? How similar?"

"It's almost exactly the same as when I was a kid. It's just that he looks a little silly when he smiles. He's not as handsome as me, and he's dumber than me." Kudo Shinichi said unceremoniously.

As for the fact that Conan was wearing empty frames on his face, considering that this was a comic book world, he didn't complain about it.

"What's more important is his name, Edogawa Conan, Edogawa Rampan's Edogawa, Conan Doyle's Conan." He mentioned another point: "This kind of name that is full of mystery novels feels like only my father can come up with it."

"That makes sense." Across the ocean, Kudo Yukiko, who was in Norway, looked at her side: "My dear, what do you think?"

This is the study room. Not only Kudo Yukiko, but Kudo Yusaku is also next to the phone.

"Dad is here too."

"A little boy between six and seven years old... Edogawa Conan." Yusaku Kudo answered the phone: "Shinichi, do you remember the location of "Two Cent Coins" in my study?"

"I remember..." Kudo Shinichi walked around the study three times last night, and he could answer with a little recall: "On the bookshelf in the northwest corner, in the middle of the second floor, next to "A Study in Scarlet"."

Then he raised the corner of his mouth and said, "The height of the second floor of the bookshelf is about the same as that of a six or seven-year-old boy. These two books next to each other are just at the same level as his perspective."

Kudo Yusaku nodded with satisfaction. As soon as he heard the name "Edogawa Conan", he thought it was a pseudonym made up by a child who saw something in a hurry.Sure enough, his son was not stupid either. He understood everything and immediately thought of this.

But Kudo Shinichi still doubted: "Think about it, a child suddenly appeared, he looks very similar to me, and he didn't tell me his real name. Dr. Agasa seemed to be covering up for him - I feel that my inheritance rights are unstable!"

"Don't worry, you alone are enough to give us a headache." Kudo Yukiko was impatient.

She could only guarantee that she had never given birth to a second child, but Kudo Yusaku, a guy who often flirted with female fans... She urgently needed to hang up the phone and interrogate him.

"Really? I have already started recording. Can you guarantee that I am really the only child of our family and the sole heir to the family property?"

"It's true, it's true, but if you keep talking nonsense, I will donate all your inheritance to the giant pandas."

With that said, Yukiko was about to hang up the phone and carefully interrogate Kudo Yusaku if he had done anything wrong to him.

Kudo Yusaku also knew what he was going to face after hanging up the phone. He stretched out his hand to stop Yukiko from hanging up the phone and answered it himself: "Shinichi, why are you so concerned about family property? Do you have something you want? And you just said this is the first thing, what is the second thing?"

Kudo Yusaku could feel that Kudo Shinichi's call had other purposes. He suspected that Kudo Shinichi was short of money, and it was a lot of money.

Although this kid still has a lot of immaturity as a detective, he shouldn't be stupid enough to indulge in gambling. Is he trading stocks to the extreme?Or want to buy something expensive?

Calculating the time, this child is already 17 years old. He can get a driver's license and drive after his birthday. Could it be that he wants a luxury car?

He was a little worried that Kudo Shinichi was affected by society's material desires and began to want luxuries such as luxury cars.Although he is a relatively famous novel writer, it can only be said that he lives a comfortable life and cannot afford to be a rich second generation like this guy who works as a Mercedes-Benz gold bar and gold barber.

"The other thing is to report it to your two elders. After all, that kid is nominally a relative of Dr. A Li, so I let him live in our house, and Xiaolan also moved in."

"Xiaolan!?" Yukiko immediately snatched the receiver away again: "You live with Xiaolan now? So soon?"

"Let's just take advantage of the situation." Kudo Shinichi said with a little pride in his tone: "So you two should not go home easily recently. What if Xiaolan sees you and runs away shyly."

"Also, I am now considered a 'family of three'." Kudo Shinichi said with a chuckle, "Should the cost of living be increased?"

"Up!" Yukiko happily agreed: "Yusaku has a sum of private money that he has been saving for two years. Mom will call you later."

Kudo Yusaku: Ah!?

The phone was hung up.

Kudo Yusaku tried to change the subject: "Yukiko, what do you think about the child Shinichi mentioned?"

"Isn't he the illegitimate child of some great writer who is showing mercy outside?" Yukiko put her hands on Kudo Yusaku's shoulders, and her whispering red lips were getting closer and closer to his ears.It was obviously a very ambiguous move, but it made the hairs on Kudo Yusaku's heart stand on end.

A middle-aged couple kisses and can have nightmares for several nights... No, it's not because of this.

"Yukiko, I have always been loyal to our marriage and have never shown mercy."

"Really? Who was the woman you secretly met at the restaurant on the 17th of last month? Don't tell me she was just a fan..."
